demonstration.narration: Checkout is reported slow. I'll keep this run's requests lasting at least two seconds so we can follow the slow path without unrelated fast traffic.
demonstration.reasoning: The current window contains normal and background events. Filtering on ${var.field} reduces that noise so we can inspect the relevant records.
demonstration.evidence: The highlighted event.duration column now holds only requests of two seconds or more. api-gateway, orders and payments all report about the same delay, so it is being passed along the checkout path. One of them can show where it starts.

demonstration.narration: I'll open one slow request from the deepest service on that path and read its service, operation and duration together, to see where the delay starts.
demonstration.reasoning: A total can look convincing even when it includes an unrelated record. Opening a typical event checks the key values together, rather than relying on a count alone.
demonstration.evidence: This slow request belongs to ${truth.finding}, on GET ${truth.scope}, and took about 3.5 seconds (event.duration counts nanoseconds): the same delay its callers report. That's the deepest service on the path, so it's where the delay starts.
